goal: Close every remaining open item in docs/ROADMAP.md so the roadmap carries no unshipped code row.

design_blocked.why: Business action outside the repo. All four CONTRACTS.md clauses stay drafts until a Philippine corporate/cyber lawyer signs off. No agent can close it.
Requires SSH from a terminal that is not ENOBUFS, plus prod DB credentials. A worktree agent has neither. Human runbook only.
PLAUD_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are live secrets that must be typed into /opt/advo/apps/api/.env on the box. Never parcelled.
Needs prod admin credentials to exercise authenticated calendar create against live data. Human-only.
Deferred by design in docs/ROADMAP.md. Needs a here.now API key and per-project build artifacts that do not exist. Do not resurface.

shared_protocol: Edit ONLY your own rows or your own describe block. Never reformat, reorder, or re-wrap a shared file. package.json / package-lock.json: no lane adds a dependency without saying so in its close-out; prefer zero new dependency. apps/api/src/utils/env.ts already registers ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and PLAUD_TOKEN — read them, do not re-declare them. bench/roadmap/roadmap-remain/scoring.mjs is the OLD tier's registry: append nothing to it; each lane writes its own bench/roadmap/final/<lane>.mjs instead.

lane.name: web
lane.ships: The public landing has no dead code behind it: every landing component in the tree is either rendered by / or gone, the footer closes the product-system story, and the mobile drawer's escape/scroll-lock/route-change behavior is covered by an automated test instead of by hand.
lane.done_when: node bench/roadmap/final/web.mjs exits 0 AND npm test exits 0 AND npm run build:web exits 0 AND node bench/roadmap/roadmap-remain/viewport-site.mjs stays green

lane.name: resilience
lane.ships: The API survives its own background work: the Plaud poller stops exhausting outbound sockets, Ask Plaud retries a reset instead of silently degrading to note-parse, and an operator can see that the box is alive and read the last N errors without SSH.
lane.surface: GET /api/health (extended) and POST /api/meeting/:id/generate-task returning method=ask on a healthy box
lane.done_when: node bench/roadmap/final/resilience.mjs exits 0 AND npm test exits 0 AND npm run build:api exits 0

lane.name: proposal
lane.ships: Generating a proposal for a lead produces AI-written body copy grounded in that lead's own scraped signals (digital/design/perf score, industry, budget) instead of a fixed template fill, with the existing template as the fallback when no key is set.
lane.surface: /admin -> Proposals -> Generate, and POST /api/proposal returning method="ai" when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set
lane.done_when: node bench/roadmap/final/proposal.mjs exits 0 AND npm test exits 0 AND npm run build:api exits 0

merge_note: web merges FIRST: it re-pins the landing source surface that bench/roadmap/roadmap-remain/viewport-site.mjs and scoring.mjs both read, so every later lane rebases onto a settled landing tree. Rebase each lane onto the tip from INSIDE its own worktree before landing it. Resolve docs/ROADMAP.md row conflicts by taking the row that says shipped; resolve any source conflict by hand — never auto-pick hunks in .ts/.tsx.
tip_gate: At the merged tip on main: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint && node bench/roadmap/final/web.mjs && node bench/roadmap/final/resilience.mjs && node bench/roadmap/final/proposal.mjs && node bench/roadmap/roadmap-remain/scoring.mjs && node bench/roadmap/roadmap-remain/viewport-site.mjs && node bench/roadmap/landing-stripe-audit/scoring.mjs. All exit 0, no check that was green before this tier turned red.

environment.note: Each lane runs its own API port and its own database so a migration in one lane cannot stomp another.
